purpose: Read-only presentation of artifacts emitted by the existing private M4 candidate; not acceptance of their runtime correctness
missing_policy: Missing inputs produce null metrics and not_run; invalid/oversized/out-of-root inputs are recorded as unavailable, never replaced by historical or example values
selection_policy: One explicitly supplied run-root. No latest-run scan, native WSL access, engine calls or network. Exact primary artifacts take precedence over embedded summary copies.

mappings.rule: true=completed, false=failed; absent plus available evidence=partial; all inputs missing=not_run

mappings.scope: actual incremental fact digest count, not historical or planned input count
